selection.interpretation: Practical internal validation gate; independent population significance is not established.
selection.policy: At least +2 percentage points development mAP50–95, better F1 at both deployed thresholds with descriptive paired intervals above zero, no precision loss above 1pp, and no legacy mAP/F1 loss above 2pp.

limitation: Internal development comparison, not an independent thesis test. V3 validation influenced checkpoint selection; v2 training exposure and specimen independence are unknown. Images from one capture date can be correlated. Image-bootstrap intervals describe this set and do not establish population significance. The legacy test set is a regression check and has already been evaluated previously.
